text: The historical Export for Mobile app-menu used upload-sm, while the accepted consumer uses --icon-mobile-export-sm and the preference category uses the large mobile-export resource. The retained small upload SVG has fill="#context-stroke". This unusual paint value is an unresolved source observation; no SVG conformance or rendering check established its effect. Check the actual resource and consumer before copying legacy paint syntax or an obsolete icon reference. The separate mobile asset role/size naming map is covered by the adjacent batch. No visual, hover, contrast or accessibility result is claimed.
title: Check icon paint values at the actual resource and consumer
